content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body: Hello, I hope you are doing well. Thank you for sharing the agreement. Before signing, I would like to propose a small adjustment: - Regarding the relevant clause, the current liability cap is restricted solely to certain claims, which leaves general obligations without a liability ceiling. I propose that the total aggregate liability of the Contractor arising out of or related to this agreement shall be subject to a fixed cap, and all indemnification obligations shall be included within and subject to such aggregate liability limit. Please let me know if this works for you. Best regards,
